high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from an Instagram post by the account "businessinsider." The post features a close-up of hands holding a Japanese chef's knife. The knife has a black handle and a metallic blade, which is partially visible as it is being held at an angle. The background is blurred, focusing attention on the knife and the hands. The hands appear to be steady, suggesting that the person is either demonstrating how to hold or use the knife or is in the process of cutting something. The post has received 27,109 likes, indicating that it has gained significant engagement.
